shared_elements: pale stone slab carved in low relief
horizontal band/line dividing the surface into registers
small repeated incised signs or motifs in rows
rounded upper contour of the slab
justification: Both are pale stone slabs whose surfaces are split by a horizontal dividing band into an upper and lower register, each filled with profile figures and small repeated motifs, and both have a rounded top edge. The manner of carving is quite different, however: A uses bold, plastic, deeply modelled animal bodies in high relief on a massive in-situ block, while B is a thin portable plaque with shallow, fine, linear incision of human figures and dense script-like signs around an offering scene.
